requirements.evidence: Code cannot run: app/Models/Entity.php:12-13 `class Entity extends \` + newline `\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model` is a parse error; app/Models/Entity.php:5 and app/Models/EntityMembership.php:5 import non-existent `Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\HasFactory`; User defines `memberships()` (app/Models/User.php:30) but middleware, /home, entity.pick, Dashboard and both policies call undefined `$user->entity_memberships()` (e.g. app/Http/Middleware/CurrentEntity.php:21, routes/web.php:26). Migration line 22 uses invalid SQL `(role = "owner" ? 1 : NULL) VIRTUAL` (ternary, not STORED). uniqueSlug() is called once, not on every attempt (CreateEntity.php:26). Lang keys `entity.create_title` are flat but looked up as nested `ui.entity.create_title`. Switcher `{{ ... 'data-current="1"' }}` is escaped into a broken attribute (switcher.blade.php:16).

conventions.evidence: No Action class for entity creation (CreateEntity.php:33-43 writes directly); inline `$this->validate([...])` instead of `#[Validate]` (CreateEntity.php:22); Dashboard authorizes by hand-rolled query instead of `$this->authorize('view', $entity)` (Dashboard.php:17); migrations are named classes with raw DB::statement, not generated-style; switcher view queries the DB in a `<?php` block (switcher.blade.php:1-5); no CHANGELOG/business-rules update; unused imports in factories and middleware.

security.evidence: EntityMembershipPolicy::delete compares cast enum to string `$membership->role === UserRole::Owner->value` (EntityMembershipPolicy.php:28), always false, so the owner's membership can be deleted by self or an admin; CreateEntity::submit has no `$this->authorize('create', Entity::class)` and no rate limit; current_entity not registered as persistent Livewire middleware. Escaping with {{ }} and $fillable are fine.

tests.evidence: The diff contains no test files at all; no feature, policy, Livewire unauthorized-call or tamper tests.

simplicity.evidence: Membership-check query duplicated across CurrentEntity.php:33, Dashboard.php:17, routes/web.php:69, EntityPolicy.php (5x) instead of reusing `membershipFor()`/policy; unnecessary AuthServiceProvider (app/Providers/AuthServiceProvider.php) for policies that Laravel auto-discovers. Otherwise code is short.

readability.evidence: Broken `extends \` line in Entity.php:12; unused imports (Str in Entity.php:10, HasFactory/Model in factories, Auth in CurrentEntity.php:6, Redirect in Dashboard.php:8); routes closures with business logic in routes/web.php:63-79; removed PHPDoc in AppServiceProvider/User.

scope.evidence: Unrelated refactor of app/Models/User.php (removed #[Fillable]/#[Hidden] attributes and casts() method, PHPDoc) and AppServiceProvider docblocks; removed blank lines in verification routes (routes/web.php:55-57). No out-of-scope features added.

issues.explanation: `class Entity extends \` followed by a newline and `\Illuminate\...Model` is a PHP parse error, so the model cannot load.
Imports `Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\HasFactory` (also EntityMembership.php:5), which does not exist; the trait lives in `Eloquent\Factories`.
Calls `$user->entity_memberships()`, which is never defined (User has `memberships()`); the same undefined call breaks /home, entity.pick, Dashboard and every policy method.
Generated column uses a C-style ternary (invalid SQL on SQLite and MariaDB) and is VIRTUAL rather than the required STORED; the one-owner constraint cannot be created.
No tests are shipped for any of the new models, policies, middleware, routes or Livewire components, which violates the project's mandatory TDD rule.
Because `role` is cast to UserRole, comparing it to the string 'owner' is always false, so delete allows removing the owner's membership.
uniqueSlug() is called once and only does Str::slug, rather than producing a unique slug on every attempt as the contract requires; an empty slug from a symbol-only name is not handled.
Flat keys 'entity.create_title' / 'entity.create_heading' are not resolved by `__('ui.entity.create_title')`, which looks up a nested array, so the raw key is displayed.
`{{ ... 'data-current="1"' }}` is HTML-escaped and outputs `data-current="1"`, so the current-entity marker attribute is broken; the page also has no 'Trocar de entidade' title.
Uses inline validate instead of `#[Validate]`, writes the domain directly instead of through an app/Actions class, and does not authorize 'create' through the policy.
Membership check is a hand-rolled query instead of `$this->authorize('view', $entity)` through EntityPolicy.
The custom `current_entity` middleware is not registered via Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware, which the Livewire policy requires.
Data is queried inside the view's PHP block instead of being passed from the route/controller.
Unrelated rewrite of User: removes #[Fillable]/#[Hidden] attributes, the casts() method and PHPDoc.
The docs update is minimal (only the owner constraint, no entities table/slug details) and CHANGELOG.md is not updated.
Extra provider to register policies that Laravel discovers automatically by naming convention.
There are unused imports here (HasFactory, Model) and in several other new files.

review.summary: The change sketches the entity models, policies, tenant middleware, onboarding, switcher and dashboard. It cannot run: Entity.php has a parse error, the HasFactory import is wrong, and the code calls `entity_memberships()`, which is never defined. The migration's owner constraint is invalid SQL, and there are no tests at all. It also has a policy bug that lets the owner's membership be deleted, plus several convention violations (no Action, no #[Validate], no policy-based authorization). It should be rejected.
